```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Set up directories
project_dir <- "path/to/adsct" # Change the path to the location of the adsct repo
subdirs <- list(
    data = file.path(project_dir, "data"),
    derivatives = file.path(project_dir, "derivatives"),
    functions = file.path(project_dir, "functions"),
    scripts = file.path(project_dir, "scripts")
)
```

```{r libraries, include=FALSE}
# Install and load the pacman library to assist with installing other libraries, then load the additional libraries with pacman

install.packages("pacman", quietly = TRUE)
library(pacman)

# Use pacman to install and load the other libraries
pacman::p_load(
    data.table,
    magrittr,
    tidyverse,
    janitor,
    readr,
    rlist,
    listr,
    sjmisc,
    vroom
)

# Load the script to calculate adsct
source(file.path(subdirs$functions, "calc_adsct.r"))
```

```{r load data, include=FALSE}
# Load the cortical thickness data
lhct <- read_table(list.files(subdirs$data, pattern = "lh"), show_col_types = FALSE) # left hemisphere

rhct = read_table(list.files(subdirs$data, pattern = "rh"), show_col_types = FALSE)# right hemisphere


```
